mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 6.0% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, which triggers a shift in investor sentiment toward risk-off behavior and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 6.0% for 3 months, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in aggregate demand, which increases the probability of a near-term economic slowdown and results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average, combined with a concurrent rise in the unemployment rate, signals a supply-side shock that disrupts corporate profitability and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPIAUCSL above 3.0% year-over-year, combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate, indicates persistent inflationary pressure that triggers a hawkish monetary policy response, leading to higher real rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY and FEDFUNDS >= 0.05%, or the interaction signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average, coupled with a rising industrial production (INDPRO), signals strong underlying demand momentum that supports corporate earnings growth and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both RSAFS > 12-month MA and INDPRO > 105, or the interaction signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 200,000 per month, combined with a declining unemployment rate, signals a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS > 200,000 and UNRATE < 6.2%, or the interaction signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below its 12-month moving average, combined with a drop in residential construction starts (HOUST), indicates a weakening in consumer and housing demand, which increases the risk of a near-term economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
